tie_breaking.token_budget_rule: admit ranked complete chunks only; stop when the next chunk does not fit; never truncate and never skip ahead

notes: All gold spans are anchored in the evidence layer (cleaned/<doc_id>.evidence.jsonl) whose offsets index the concatenated retained block texts.
Clause spans are stable: chunking never redefines a clause boundary, so one clause may span several chunks while its annotated span is unchanged.
Token-budget comparisons admit complete chunks in rank order and stop at the first chunk that does not fit.
